title: NCPIA 2.0.0 is here — diving into everything that's new 🚀
author: mcxtrends
selftext:
hey everyone as some of you may know I launched NCPIA 2 months ago. gave a few updates but disappeared for a bit. well I'm back with ncpia 2.0  Update. 

new features, better design, less ads, more stable. 

Available on Playstore, coming soon on IOS

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ncpialtd.ncpia

🎥 P2P Video Chat

Video chat other traders directly in the app. Filter by asset category or a specific asset like gold, and get matched with someone trading the same thing you are.

📞 Mutual Calls

Call your mutual followers directly. No more DMing to ask if they're free.

📸 Photos, Videos & Reels

Post images and videos in the social layer now, plus Reels for quick trading content.

🧠 Smart Algorithm

Learns and evolves with the traders and content on the app, so your feed keeps getting better.

🙅 Fewer Ads

Cut ads across the app for a cleaner, richer experience.

For those who don't know NCPIA:

It's a trading terminal with a strong social layer. Live prices, analysis and news on 230+ macro assets (forex, indices, crypto, commodities). 

Live tracker for 6,000+ global stocks, fully filterable. News from 100+ sources worldwide. 

Instant translation for news and analysis in 50+ languages.

Track the markets. Meet the traders. That's NCPIA.

Built for traders, by the traders.
